claim_boundary: These fixtures certify failures of specified arguments only. They do not refute universal critical integrability.

fixtures.title: Reversed finite-measure inclusion
fixtures.false_claim: L2(0,T) implies L4(0,T) because T is finite.
fixtures.exact_test: For f(t)=t^(-1/3) on (0,1), verify integral f^2=3 and integral f^4 diverges.

fixtures.title: Incorrect energy interpolation endpoint
fixtures.false_claim: Interpolation of L-infinity_t L2_x and L2_t L6_x yields L4_t L6_x.
fixtures.exact_test: Set 1/q=theta/2 and 1/p=(1-theta)/2+theta/6. q=4 gives theta=1/2 and p=3; p=6 gives theta=1 and q=2.

fixtures.title: Hidden uniform H1 bound
fixtures.false_claim: The product of the known L2_tL6_x norm with a harmless supremum proves the target.
fixtures.exact_test: Identify the missing factor as the unproved L-infinity_t L6_x norm, implied by L-infinity_t H1_x.

fixtures.title: Circular Gronwall closure
fixtures.false_claim: The H1 Gronwall bound can be fed back to prove the integral controlling that same bound.
fixtures.exact_test: Reduce the proposed closure to X <= K exp(cX) and verify that it gives no finite upper bound on X.

fixtures.title: Inadmissible minus-Laplacian test
fixtures.false_claim: Every Leray-Hopf solution may be directly tested by -Delta u.
fixtures.exact_test: Check whether Delta u belongs to L2_tL2_x and whether the time derivative pairing defining d/dt ||grad u||2^2 is available in the Leray-Hopf class.

fixtures.title: Pressure cancellation without admissibility
fixtures.false_claim: Formal pressure cancellation makes the H1 test valid at weak regularity.
fixtures.exact_test: Separate the smooth algebraic identity from the existence of the pressure pairing and admissibility of Delta u.

fixtures.title: Nonuniform Galerkin bound
fixtures.false_claim: Finiteness for each cutoff N passes to the continuum.
fixtures.exact_test: Use ||P_<=N v||6 <= C N ||v||2 to obtain I_T(P_<=N u) <= C T N^4 sup_t ||u||2^4.

fixtures.title: Nonuniform mollification bound
fixtures.false_claim: Mollified critical norms pass to the limit by smoothness alone.
fixtures.exact_test: Use ||rho_epsilon*u||6 <= C epsilon^(-1)||u||2 to obtain an epsilon^(-4) loss in the fourth-power integral.

fixtures.title: Compact-support promotion
fixtures.false_claim: A theorem for C_c-infinity data covers all rapidly decreasing smooth data.
fixtures.exact_test: Verify strict inclusion C_c-infinity subsetneq Schwartz and require a uniform solution-stability and critical-norm extension theorem.

fixtures.title: Numerical boundedness overclaim
fixtures.false_claim: Finite measured integrals at finite resolutions imply continuum regularity.
fixtures.exact_test: Require a resolution-uniform bound, verified critical-norm error, convergence to the relevant weak class, and subgrid concentration control.

fixtures.title: Formalized assumption overclaim
fixtures.false_claim: A kernel-checked implication from an assumed universal estimate is a proof of that estimate.
fixtures.exact_test: Inspect the theorem assumptions and provenance; the open estimate must remain visible as an imported assumption.

fixtures.title: Exponent-order confusion
fixtures.false_claim: L4_tL6_x and L6_tL4_x represent the same Serrin pair.

fixtures.title: Interior-to-global theorem drift
fixtures.false_claim: Interior regularity alone supplies the global whole-space continuation theorem.
fixtures.exact_test: Check initial-time, whole-space decay, global energy, and uniqueness hypotheses separately.

fixtures.title: Existential-to-universal solution drift
fixtures.false_claim: One selected regular weak solution proves the statement for every Leray-Hopf solution.
fixtures.exact_test: Require a matching weak-strong uniqueness theorem that identifies all weak solutions on the interval.
